title: Be a Diligent, Respectful, and Caring Steward
coreMove: Stewardship is visible when schedule pressure changes the decision: protect people, evidence, compliance, resources, and trust before defending a convenient baseline.

exampleSpecs.domain: kickoff checklist for a regulated software project
exampleSpecs.audience: a project manager converting principle language into review evidence
exampleSpecs.stakes: whether ethics and compliance become lived duties or signoff words
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: show the same checklist before and after stewardship changes what gets recorded

exampleSpecs.audience: a quality lead checking whether pressure distorted the record
exampleSpecs.stakes: whether a baseline stayed green by hiding a resource tradeoff
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: the audit discovers that the project moved risk out of sight

exampleSpecs.audience: a product lead tempted to treat file completion as readiness
exampleSpecs.stakes: whether private data gets sent before the open check is resolved
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: the wrong turn happens inside one person's reasoning

exampleSpecs.domain: Friday planning session with scarce review time
exampleSpecs.audience: a planning lead allocating attention before execution begins
exampleSpecs.stakes: whether adoption and resource concerns vanish under date pressure
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: attention allocation is the whole scene

exampleSpecs.domain: test failure before a steering call
exampleSpecs.audience: a release lead facing two costly paths
exampleSpecs.stakes: whether a known defect is disclosed before a public promise changes
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: a two-bad-options decision exposes whether principle language changes behavior

exampleSpecs.domain: sponsor-call preparation around a procurement exception
exampleSpecs.audience: a delivery lead and sponsor aligning principle words with the call script
exampleSpecs.stakes: whether a hidden exception is masked by polished principle language
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: the exchange ties PMI words to the exception that must be named
